properties.content: Question: covid symptoms for children Answer: Common Symptoms of COVID-19 in Children:: Fever, Cough, Runny nose, Sore throat, Fatigue, Headache, Muscle aches, Nausea, Vomiting, and Diarrhea. Less Common Symptoms: Congestion, Shortness of breath, Loss of taste or smell, Pink eye, and Seizures (rare). Symptoms in Infants and Young Children: Fever, Irritability, Lethargy, Decreased appetite, Vomiting, and Diarrhea. Note: Some children may be asymptomatic or have very mild symptoms. It is important to monitor your child for any symptoms and seek medical attention if they develop any concerning signs.

Question: covid symptoms for children

Answer: Common Symptoms of COVID-19 in Children::
Fever, Cough, Runny nose, Sore throat, Fatigue, Headache, Muscle aches, Nausea, Vomiting, and Diarrhea.
Less Common Symptoms:
Congestion, Shortness of breath, Loss of taste or smell, Pink eye, and Seizures (rare).
Symptoms in Infants and Young Children:
Fever, Irritability, Lethargy, Decreased appetite, Vomiting, and Diarrhea.
Note: Some children may be asymptomatic or have very mild symptoms. It is important to monitor your child for any symptoms and seek medical attention if they develop any concerning signs.
